title: SKY Castle
hook: How does SKY Castle end? Hye-na's death, the unmasking of coordinator Kim Joo-young, and the families who flee the neighborhood in the finale, explained.

sections.heading: Where the finale leaves the families
sections.body: By the final episodes, the wealthy enclave of SKY Castle is cracking under the pressure of elite college admissions. Han Seo-jin has staked everything on getting her daughter Kang Ye-seo into Seoul National University's medical school, guided by the ruthless admissions coordinator Kim Joo-young, who boasts a perfect success rate. The arrival of Kim Hye-na, revealed to be the biological daughter of Seo-jin's husband from a past relationship, destabilizes the household, while writer-neighbor Lee Soo-im watches the obsession curdle into something dangerous.

sections.heading: The death that breaks everything
sections.body: The story's hinge is Hye-na's death. She falls from a building during Hwang Woo-joo's birthday celebration, and the kind student Woo-joo, who has feelings for Ye-seo, is initially arrested as the prime suspect. The investigation reveals it was not a simple accident or suicide. The drama points toward Ye-seo being suspected of pushing Hye-na, while also strongly implicating coordinator Kim Joo-young in manipulating events behind the scenes to protect her flawless record at any human cost.

sections.heading: The coordinator unmasked
sections.body: Kim Joo-young's facade finally collapses. She is shown to have cruelly told Hye-na she was merely a tool used by her client's parents, and her hand in engineering the girl's death is exposed, though Seo-jin had earlier conspired with her to cover the crime up. Confronted with the truth, the coordinator and the school principal's nephew, who had leaked exam papers, are arrested. Woo-joo is cleared and released once evidence surfaces. The woman who sold perfection to desperate parents is revealed as the rot at the center of the neighborhood.

sections.heading: Leaving the castle
sections.body: The payoff is a chastened scattering of the families. Ye-seo, expelled and disillusioned, gives up the Seoul National University path, takes a GED instead, and enters college the following year on her own terms. Lee Soo-im publishes her expose novel about life inside SKY Castle, turning the scandal into a warning. Min-hyeok of the Cha family softens his harsh parenting and reconciles with his children. One by one the families leave the enclave to rebuild, the drama arguing that the pursuit of prestige had been quietly destroying them all.

final_image: The families depart the SKY Castle enclave to rebuild their lives, the perfect facade of the neighborhood finally abandoned after the scandal tears it open.

lingering_questions.q: Who is responsible for Hye-na's death?
lingering_questions.a: The drama leaves blame layered. Ye-seo is suspected of pushing Hye-na, who fell from a building during Woo-joo's party, while coordinator Kim Joo-young is heavily implicated in manipulating the events. Her role in the death is ultimately exposed.

lingering_questions.q: What happens to the coordinator Kim Joo-young?
lingering_questions.a: Her perfect-record facade collapses. After her cruelty toward Hye-na and her hand in the girl's death are exposed, Kim Joo-young is arrested, along with the principal's nephew who had leaked exam papers.

lingering_questions.q: Does Kang Ye-seo go to Seoul National University?
lingering_questions.a: No. Expelled and disillusioned by the scandal, Ye-seo forgoes the SNU medical-school path, takes a GED instead, and enters college the following year on her own terms.
